title: MV How to change NPC's/Event's offset

posts.author: Mandelic_Mark
posts.body:
For the past day I have been trying to figure out how do I change the character's offset, but I couldn't find any solution as the ones I found either weren't for MV, were unsovled or were locked behind a paywall
I basically want to change the character's/event's hitbox to be located in the feet area, but due to how the RPG Maker MV hitboxes works, it forces it into the bottom of the character, which in this case is the head area
I would gladly appreciate any help with this issue

posts.author: bgillisp
posts.body: You'll be needing a plugin as the hitboxes are coded into the engine. Yes that may require paying.

posts.author: I_LIKE_BREAD7
posts.body:
One simple way you can do this without a plugin is this:
Add this script call
JavaScript:
$gameMap.event(1).shiftY = () => -48
to some autorun or parallel event to shift the character's sprite down. Replace "48" with your character's height (but keep the minus sign), and "1" with the character's event id. If it's supposed to be the player do
JavaScript:
$gamePlayer.shiftY = () => -48
instead. You can also adjust the "48" value to whatever fits the most for your game.
The event / player will be displayed one tile below it's actual position, making it effectively have a hitbox above itself. If you need something more sophisticated you might need a plugin, though.

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
Actually there are no hitboxes in the default engine at all, the default works by coordinate comparison.
and since the sprites are centered bottom by default, the lower end of the tall sprites is where the event is located as far as the engine assumes.
which means you can either use a plugin that creates hitboxes, or one that allows you to change where the sprite is centered (what you call changing the offset).
@Synrec
tip above will not work, because blank space can only move the sprite up, not down - there is no negative space on a spritesheet that is centered bottom.

posts.author: ElvenNeko
posts.body:
This plugin is very good for percise offsetting:
https://taaspider.itch.io/taa-eventoffset
The only problem that at the start of the map the imagies will move from starting position to their offset position. This can be avoided to having a screen fade out before entering the location, and fading in after wait of 30 frames on autorun (then switching off, and switching on again after player leaves). This way the movement will happen offscreen.

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
ElvenNeko said:
(then switching off, and switching on again after player leaves).
Click to expand...
bad idea - instead after the fade-in you use the erase event command.
erased events are automatically reloaded on entering a map, so no need with any switches (or forgetting to reset them)

posts.body: Qmovement could change the event hitbox but that will require you to not use other walking system.
